responsibility: Declares supporting data structures and helpers shared by the tree SSA reassociation pass. It defines operand_entry for ranked flattened operands and range_entry for tracked range facts, and exports dump/initialization utilities and side-effect-free block predicates used by reassociation and related arithmetic simplification code.
same_name_distinction: Defines supporting reassociation data structures such as operand_entry and range_entry, and declares utility helpers like range dumping/init and no_side_effect_bb. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-reassoc.cc, it is the shared support header, not the reassociation pass implementation.
